name: UI: player lobby
description: The player lobby as concept renders 11, 24 and 37 draw it, drawn for a television read from a sofa: the session's name, up to six seat cards (ready, creating, open), a join code with a placeholder QR picture, the party summary and the one Begin Adventure button. The backdrop is the generated hall, with no interface painted in. The QR picture is a placeholder, not a scannable code.

lobby.title: The Ashen Citadel Awaits
lobby.subtitle: A lost stronghold. Ancient machines. A power that should have stayed buried.

join.hint: Scan, or enter the game code

phone.goal: Wait for the table to fill
narration: Four players are at the table. Two seats are still open.
